SELECT rbs.rbs_id AS resumeId, IFNULL(u.nick_name, rbs.rbs_resume_name) AS name, u.phonenumber AS phone, u.email AS email, rbs.rbs_job_direction AS jobName, rbs.rbs_created_at AS uploadTime, (SELECT tal.tal_matched_score FROM t_tal tal WHERE tal.tal_user_id = rbs.rbs_user_id ORDER BY tal.tal_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS matchScore, (SELECT tal.tal_status FROM t_tal tal WHERE tal.tal_user_id = rbs.rbs_user_id ORDER BY tal.tal_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS statusCode FROM t_res_base rbs LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = rbs.rbs_user_id
AND (IFNULL(u.nick_name, rbs.rbs_resume_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%'))
AND rbs.rbs_job_direction LIKE CONCAT('%', #{jobName}, '%')
ORDER BY rbs.rbs_created_at DESC, rbs.rbs_id DESC

SELECT rbs.rbs_id AS resumeId, IFNULL(u.nick_name, rbs.rbs_resume_name) AS name, u.phonenumber AS phone, u.email AS email, rbs.rbs_job_direction AS jobName, rbs.rbs_created_at AS uploadTime FROM t_res_base rbs LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = rbs.rbs_user_id WHERE rbs.rbs_id = #{rbsId}

SELECT wrk_id AS workId, wrk_company AS company, wrk_department AS department, wrk_position AS position, DATE_FORMAT(wrk_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(wrk_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, wrk_is_current AS isCurrent, wrk_description AS description FROM t_res_work WHERE wrk_resume_id = #{rbsId} ORDER BY wrk_start_date DESC

SELECT edu_id AS eduId, edu_school AS school, edu_degree AS degree, edu_major AS major, DATE_FORMAT(edu_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(edu_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, edu_description AS description FROM t_res_education WHERE edu_resume_id = #{rbsId} ORDER BY edu_start_date DESC
SELECT skl_id AS skillId, skl_name AS name, skl_level AS level FROM t_res_skill WHERE skl_resume_id = #{rbsId} ORDER BY skl_level DESC, skl_id ASC

SELECT prj_id AS projId, prj_name AS name, prj_role AS role, prj_tech_stack AS techStack, DATE_FORMAT(prj_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(prj_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, prj_description AS description FROM t_res_project WHERE prj_resume_id = #{rbsId} ORDER BY prj_start_date DESC
SELECT tal.tal_status AS statusCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_tal tal GROUP BY tal.tal_status
